propositions: Deterministic parse and validation logic from structured.parse_structured must be exposed through a Pydantic TextOutput output function that raises ModelRetry on retryable StructuredOutputError while preserving the original error in __cause__

Stop and refusal safety checks from structured.check_response must run via an after_model_request capability hook before output parsing, raising terminal UnretryableOutputError without triggering Pydantic retry
The adapter in pai_output.py must preserve existing deterministic repair, sentinel extraction, and provider safety behavior without adding new retry loops or provider selection logic
A real Pydantic Agent wired with the adapter output function and capability must produce typed objects for valid responses and maintain backward compatibility with the structured.py oracle
